title: Reading Drill — Recording seasonal light for a mural — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Recording seasonal light for a mural — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Hillswick began with reports of paint colours looking different across the same wall. The mural planner had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using photographic comparisons and chose colour differences at set hours as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a test of sample panels in place. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted eight weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded nearby buildings casting shadows as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
